verdict.rationale: Evidence shows building blocks for lifecycle automation — SCIM provisioning for app-by-app account management and event hooks that fire outbound calls on org events — but nothing describes Okta's actual no-code workflow builder or explicit hire/role-change/departure triggers as a packaged capability. Event hooks require a custom HTTPS endpoint you build, not a no-code flow, so the 'no-code' claim in the story is unsupported by the pack. missing for 10: explicit no-code Workflows product docs, named hire/role-change/departure triggers, app-by-app choreography examples, independent corroboration of no-code usage.
